name: חֶסֶד
summary: The father of one of Solomon's twelve officers over Israel, who provided food for the king's household one month in the year; the officer is named only as בֶּן־חֶסֶד “son of Hesed”, and his district was Arubboth, with Socoh and all the land of Hepher. The name is the noun חֶסֶד, “kindness, loyalty”.

evidence.note: “בֶּן־חֶסֶד, in Arubboth; to him belonged Socoh and all the land of Hepher.”
“Solomon had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided for the king and his household.”

note: TIPNR keeps Ben-hesed (the officer) and Hesed (his father) as two persons; the text names only “son of Hesed”, so both are tagged here under the one name. BDB's b.ca.am is the compound בֶּן־חֶסֶד; the tokens are also counted under the noun h.ed.ab.
